title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, templates, and docs site updates
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Provide concrete, cross-language quickstarts and template examples for RAG + agent tool-calling to help developers adopt tool integrations quickly. This PR adds opinionated RAG templates, step-by-step quickstarts for Python and TypeScript, several runnable examples in redwood-examples, and docs site updates with new sidebar sections. Summary of changes: added new /templates/rag-agent templates, three quickstart guides (python, typescript, docker), multiple example apps demonstrating tool-calling (calendar, search, and db-read/write), updated docs nav and landing copy, small compatibility shim for the tool-calling SDK surface, and CI/test coverage for the examples. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates and example tool adapters - [x] Add quickstarts for Python and TypeScript with copy-paste snippets - [x] Add runnable examples to redwood-examples package - [x] Update docs site (redwood-docs) with guides and sidebar entries - [x] Add basic unit/integration tests for examples - [x] Ensure no breaking changes to public SDKs - [x] Run docs build and example CI matrix Notes: The description contains implementation notes, usage examples, and migration guidance. The docs update includes clear instructions for pinning model versions when using tool-calling with RAG and guidance for configuring retry/backoff when a tool endpoint is flaky. Related work: linked to Linear ENG-2319 (RAG quickstart initiative) and ENG-2401 (tool-calling SDK cleanup).
